name: Goldex — Coin Extractor
desc: Playable 2D/3D game visualizing the extractor model behind distance-based bounds on strong structural controllability. Move horizontal and vertical extractors across a coin grid — mechanics that directly mirror the combinatorial structure of the research.

name: Speak
desc: Native macOS presentation app. Compose PDFs, videos, and images into a single plan with per-slide hotkeys for branching, live pen/highlighter drawing overlay, and fullscreen HUD. Built entirely on Apple frameworks — no dependencies.

name: Lame
desc: macOS app for browsing and deleting photos and videos from USB-connected phones. iPhones via ImageCaptureCore; Android via libmtp with an ADB fallback for Samsung Galaxy devices. Thumbnail grid, bulk deletion, sorting and filtering.

name: PDF Util
desc: Desktop PDF page-management app. Drag-and-drop reordering, extraction, deletion, insertion from another PDF, rotation, and full-resolution page preview. Undo/redo for all operations. Cross-platform via Electron.

name: Quiz Game
desc: Live classroom quiz tool: a PDF question bank fills the screen while a sidebar tracks scores for up to five teams against a 90-minute countdown. Correct/Incorrect/Pass buttons and full keyboard shortcuts — no setup, just open and play.

name: Exam Timer
desc: Full-featured countdown timer for exam halls. Preset durations, custom time entry, add-5-minutes button, editable title, light/dark theme, animation controls, fullscreen mode, and state persistence across refreshes.

name: PMI Conflict-Graph Game
desc: Interactive builder for the bipartite conflict graph behind PMI sequences. Click grid cells to add or remove points; a maximum matching, the exact optimum value, and one longest PMI sequence update immediately — a hands-on companion to the Erdős–Szekeres-type discrete math result.

name: PMI Algorithm Sweep
desc: Step-by-step visualizer for the O(N log N) matching-sweep algorithm underlying the PMI Conflict-Graph Game: row activation, the ordered set of available rows, the smallest-successor query, and each committed matching edge, checked live against the quadratic dynamic program.

name: Math Circle Decks
desc: Three dependency-free interactive presentations for 90-minute grades 6–10 math circles: GLITCH! (parity and error-correcting codes), The Totally Honest Carnival (probability and expected value), and Monster Party (graph coloring and constraints). Live games, timers, and reveals built into the slides.

name: Monty Hall: Trusting Intuition?
desc: Cinematic 11-slide lecture deck motivating probability through the Monty Hall problem. Animated door reveals, a live Monte Carlo simulation up to 50,000 games, and a 100-door version to break the 50/50 intuition.

name: CrowdFunding DApp
desc: Fully decentralized crowdfunding platform on Ethereum. Community members propose projects, vote, execute approved proposals, and contribute funds — all through auditable smart contracts with a React frontend.

name: Set Operations Practice
desc: Flashcard quiz for discrete math students. Each round generates two random sets and asks for the union, intersection, or set difference — with four multiple-choice answers and instant feedback.
